name: AMIS addons
description: Segmentation methods for the AMIS addon marketplace. Packages are release assets; this file is the catalogue.

addons.name: Otsu threshold
addons.description: Classical Otsu baseline: one global intensity cut, optional invert, metrics against a reference mask. The control every learned method is compared to. Left the application core in 0.1.5.
addons.author: AMIS core team

versions.changelog: First catalogue release. Moved out of the core, so the application ships no method. Fixes: double cursor restore, multi-class references collapsed to foreground (and stated in the metrics line), reference-mask lookup no longer matches a bare <stem>.png, warning when the mask covers the whole frame.

addons.name: refWRANet
addons.description: Multilayer retinal segmentation with a wavelet residual attention U-Net, plus a step-by-step 2-D DWT explorer (LL/LH/HL/HH, Haar, Daubechies, Symlets, biorthogonal). Bundled demo model: mean class Dice 0.636 on OCTAVE layers.
addons.author: AMIS core team

versions.changelog: ONNX prediction uses the model's own input size (the bundled model is 160 px; a stale Image size gave 'Got: 192 Expected: 160'). sym6 added: 12 taps, orthogonal, available to the network and the DWT tab. Scrolls without requiring 0.1.5: local ScrollPage fallback, so it installs on 0.1.4 again. Model unchanged.
Small-screen layouts: both tabs scroll (the panel used to require 1394 px of height), image views shrink to 96-170 px and grow to fill. Requires the scroll_pages capability.

First release: 14-class retinal layers with the WRANet backbone, per-class Dice, colour class maps, ONNX export, and a 2-D DWT teaching tab across Haar/Daubechies/Symlets/biorthogonal families. Bundled demo model (3 volumes, mean class Dice 0.636). Requires AMIS 0.1.3.

addons.name: WRANet
addons.description: WRANet family: 14-class retinal segmentation with residual attention. 1.0-1.1 use wavelet downsampling (1.1.4 is the trained 14-class demo, Dice 0.638); 2.0.0 adds a pooling encoder, channel + spatial RAM, a DWT-LL ablation and a training-free wavelet analysis.
addons.author: AMIS core team

versions.changelog: Pooling encoder + channel/spatial residual attention, DWT-LL downsampling ablation, training-free wavelet analysis. New topology: 1.1.x weights are not compatible and no weights are bundled; pin 1.1.4 for the trained 14-class demo.
Max-pool attention U-Net on the refWRANet code base, 14 classes, bundled OCTAVE demo (mean class Dice 0.638). Backfilled into the catalogue: the release existed but had no entry.
Layout only: the five tabs scroll, with a self-contained scroll page, so the addon installs on 0.1.4 as well as 0.1.5. Model and bundled ONNX unchanged.
Small-screen layouts: the five tabs are scroll pages, the preview can shrink. Model, recipe and bundled ONNX unchanged.
First standalone release; 32.47 M parameters at the defaults.
Withdrawn: the release asset was never published, so the download is a 404. Use 1.0.2 instead.
ONNX model field and bundled models/*.onnx fallback, so an addon can ship a trained network; scripts/export_onnx.py verifies parity.
Trained model bundled: WRANet 2.03 M parameters on OCTAVE FLU, 192 px, Dice 0.450 on fluid validation slices; ONNX included with parity 5.7e-06. Code GPL-3.0, weights CC BY-SA 4.0.
ONNX: use the model's declared input size (a 192 px export no longer fails with 'Got 256 Expected 192'); progress bar, status and wait cursor while segmenting.

addons.name: Attention U-Net
addons.description: Oktay et al. (2018) attention-gated U-Net. The conventional baseline for the WRANet comparison: max-pooling instead of wavelet downsampling and no residual add in the gate.
addons.author: AMIS core team

versions.changelog: First release: full training/prediction/export panel, declarative GUI, 0.09 M parameters at base=8 depth=3.

addons.name: U-Net
addons.description: Ronneberger et al. (2015) U-Net: symmetric encoder-decoder with concatenated skip connections. The reference architecture the other methods are compared against.
addons.author: AMIS core team

versions.changelog: First release. 22.45 M parameters.

addons.name: UNet++
addons.description: Zhou et al. (2018) UNet++: nested, densely connected decoder pathways that narrow the semantic gap between encoder and decoder features.
addons.author: AMIS core team

versions.changelog: First release. 2.29 M parameters.

addons.name: ResUNet
addons.description: Residual U-Net: residual convolution blocks with identity shortcuts in both encoder and decoder, strided-convolution downsampling, transposed-convolution upsampling.
addons.author: AMIS core team

versions.changelog: First release. 2.03 M parameters.

addons.name: Flat-field threshold
addons.description: Illumination-robust threshold: estimates the background with a large box mean, divides it out, and keeps pixels a few percent brighter than that local level. No training required.
addons.author: AMIS core team

versions.changelog: First release. no parameters.

addons.name: Frangi vesselness
addons.description: Frangi et al. (1998) multiscale Hessian vesselness: enhances tubular structures such as vessels and aneurysm necks, with a polarity switch for dark or bright structures.
addons.author: AMIS core team

versions.changelog: First release. no parameters.

addons.name: WRANet Layers
addons.description: WRANet backbone with one output channel per class: retinal layers and fluid spaces in one pass (14 OCTAVE classes). Wavelet downsampling keeps the thin layer boundaries; attention gates re-weight the skips.
addons.author: AMIS core team

versions.changelog: First release: multi-class layer segmentation on the WRANet backbone (CE + Dice, per-class metrics, class-index masks, ONNX export with N channels). Requires AMIS 0.1.3 for the multi-class trainer.
